product_one_liner.value: Together AI provides cloud infrastructure for AI engineers and researchers to build, fine-tune, and deploy open-source AI models, spanning inference services and GPU clusters.

named_customers.notes: Both are explicitly identified as customers.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reports 436 employees; LinkedIn displays 440 associated employees.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include Together Compiler, by Reyna Abhyankar, Dylan Lim, and Simran Arora, and ThunderAgent, by Hao Kang and coauthors, covering inference optimization and scheduling.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes an overview, model catalogs, and privacy and security guidance.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Machine Learning Engineer - Inference has an application posting.

model_provider.value: DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mistral models, hosted on Together AI's own infrastructure.
model_provider.notes: Together states that these deployments do not call the model authors' services or send them user requests.

raised_18mo.notes: The $800 million round announced July 1, 2026 falls within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Strategic Account Executive has an application posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced Together Compiler, a continual inference-optimization system, on November 4, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Together announced Alon Gavrielov joining as VP of Infrastructure Strategy on February 3, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The GTM Engineer posting names both systems in its CRM and data-centralization responsibilities.
